description: This is a shell script that provides command-line utility functions for managing OCI containers, including starting, stopping, listing, and executing commands within containers. It interacts with an external REST API via curl and includes an interactive command loop.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a specified bundle directory or tarball, sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts an OCI container using a Dobby JSON specification file, sending request via curl.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by container ID.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container with optional parameters.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop that reads user input and dispatches commands to the above functions, creating an interactive CLI.
